content: Clerk Dashboard User & Authentication page toggles email/password sign-up and sign-in; Google SSO connection needs 'Enable for sign-up and sign-in' plus, for production instances, 'Use custom credentials' with a Google Cloud OAuth client (dev uses Clerk's shared credentials automatically). Password reset via email link is a built-in custom-flow option in Clerk's SignIn component. Cross-checked with a direct WebFetch of clerk.com's Google social-connection page.
